note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Only the supplied relationships are drawn, with their kind; a causal arrow appears only where the author supplies kind 'causal'. The stated difference is shown only as supplied; nothing is computed or valued and no damages, compensation, liability, fault or causation conclusion is drawn. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; subject floor: 'Subject ≥ 0.20 of the frame height at rest and hold (causation-05 LAW-0700 decision)', production/SESSION_HANDOFF.md). True driver: the 1:1 box (each balance column on its stand must reach 0.20 of the frame height). After trying the fallback layouts (objects beside the record; record column with the band; top band with the inset beside the record and the objects below, its chip beside or under the inset; record over the objects; stacked or side-by-side captions), the full stress counts did not fit 1:1 without the fallback scale. Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-09-27): full counts (five entries, two alternatives, two labelled links, two stated items, five elements) → 1:1 fallback scale k 0.909, smallest text 15.4 px, columns 0.096 of the frame height; 16:9 20.0 px / 0.240; 9:16 21.0 px / 0.210. Five entries without alternatives/links: 1:1 column 0.199 (under the floor). The stress keeps every text at its near-maximum length and caps the COUNTS at four entries, no alternative, no link note, one stated item and the four baseline elements (baseline 3 / 0 / 0 / 1 / 4); after the cap: 1:1 20.0 px / 0.245 without scaling; 16:9 23.0 px / 0.325; 9:16 22.0 px / 0.315. Every field stays longer than the baseline and every count ≥ the baseline.
